title: Controlled vegetable fermentation
summary: Use tested salt, temperature, submersion and observation controls rather than improvising.
steps: Use a current tested recipe for the exact fermented product and batch size.
Measure ingredients, salt or brine exactly with clean equipment.
Keep vegetables submerged as the method specifies and use a clean suitable food-grade vessel.
Maintain the stated fermentation temperature and inspect regularly for the normal versus unsafe signs described by the recipe.
Refrigerate, process or store only as the tested method directs; discard soft, slimy, mouldy or foul-smelling failures.
